cold_start.consumer: verified trace PID executable plus Linux process birth to first completed FreezeDetector frame; wrapper/Xvfb start recorded separately
cold_start.cache_boundary: fresh process/config/system directory; OS page cache retained and recorded

project_indexing.consumer: real symbol-index membership and busy intervals overlapping completed native frames
project_indexing.require: finish indexing without blocking all UI frames; Smart/Dumb status visible in screenshot

typing_highlighting.consumer: raw typed text arrival through completed native frame, including highlighter/layout

completion.consumer: real request to drawn nonempty popup

memory.consumer: Linux /proc verified RustPy PID and descendants; wrapper/Xvfb RSS retained only as separate whole-tree safety evidence

cancellation.consumer: superseded scheduler request ID through actual cancelled worker return; request-only timing forbidden

cache.consumer: existing analysis cache plus analysis_cache_hit native events

million_line_analysis.consumer: existing ignored 128-file project diagnostic/cache/identity assertions; no single giant file surrogate
million_line_analysis.build: release test binary built outside the memory watchdog (or --test-binary); only the binary runs under it

parallel_analysis.boundary: roadmap asks for parallel analysis across cores without a core count; measured at --cores (default 10) with cores-1 workers; a 2-core run leaves one worker and is diagnostic only

power_save.consumer: real action toggles, mode transitions and absence of analysis_start while active, then resume

invalidate_caches.consumer: actual cache replacement/index rebuild admission event and subsequent full membership

shared_indexes.require: explicit final controlled local HTTPS endpoint download/cancel/checksum/trust evidence; normal native performance runs never access a mirror

watchers.consumer: recursive registration plus exact externally written sentinel delivery
watchers.require: central regression fixture plus native inotify limits warning and safe user-invoked fix inspection; do not alter host sysctls automatically

large_file.consumer: real is_large_file() and bounded viewport layouts while navigating start/end

virtualization.consumer: actual layouts.len(), visible range and clip geometry

gpu_and_fallback.require: one hardware adapter run and one llvmpipe/softpipe/software renderer run; requested environment is not adapter evidence

freeze_detector.consumer: existing watchdog/report UI; native frame JSONL includes submillisecond durations
freeze_detector.require: controlled final stall fixture and actual freeze warning/UI evidence, not an ordinary fast-frame assertion

memory_indicator_reduce_memory.require: native screenshot and displayed RSS cross-check against sampled process RSS
memory_indicator_reduce_memory.optional_boundary: Reduce IDE memory is a question-mark roadmap suggestion; no such action exists and none is claimed

platform_boundaries: Linux native driver only; no Windows/macOS latency, memory, GPU, watcher or presentation claim
GUI checks only via scripts/smoke.sh with its private Xvfb; forced software rendering leaves hardware acceptance unavailable
frame end measures CPU layout completion, not compositor/display presentation
whole acceptance requires all native stages, five cold starts, existing targeted source suites and the explicit remaining controlled UI/network/platform evidence

native_execution.display: private Xvfb created by wrapper; real DISPLAY removed
native_execution.trust: RUSTPY_SMOKE_UNTRUSTED=1; only generated canonical project trusted via isolated settings
native_execution.binary: actual ./target/<profile>/rustpy SHA must match --binary/--release-binary and verified /proc trace-PID executable
native_execution.native_seconds: 60..900 wrapper timeout; capture after min(seconds-20,90)s once the input script finished, deadline seconds-5; unreached mark steps fail
native_execution.trace: --trace-max-rows (default 1000000) with explicit trace_truncated failure; --trace-count-only kinds (default frame) are counted only
native_execution.memory: app PID and app-tree RSS separately from entire wrapper/Xvfb owned-tree safety watchdog
